authorization.allowed_source: local pinned Git objects and frozen report/evidence records
authorization.scope_rule: requests must match one experiment_item_id and one allowed_tool_locators entry
authorization.execution_rule: R2 remains blocked unless the authorization record is structurally valid and execution.execution_authorized=true.

result_envelope.semantics: ok is a tool execution result only; it never marks evidence_gate met and never means safe or miss. partial/not_found/out_of_scope/failed/timed_out/budget_exhausted remain unknown evidence.
result_envelope.citation_rule: Each claim reference must be a supplied-catalog evidence_id/fact_id for the current experiment_item_id or an evidence_id from a persisted tool result for that same item.
result_envelope.persistence_rule: A claim may cite an envelope evidence_id only after the result is persisted with a unique persistence_id, artifact_sha256, current experiment_item_id, and independent attempt_id.

tools.purpose: return fixed Git-object source excerpt for an allowed locator
return fixed evidence-gate obligation definitions and current candidate-independent statuses
return bounded history/diff context for the pinned commit and allowed file
return recorded Detector symbol/parse summary without expanding into arbitrary analysis
